newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Trust to issue up to 110 bln yen of CBs.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Trust to issue up to 110 bln yen of CBs.

text.p: Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd said on Monday it would issue yen-denominated subordinated convertible bonds worth up to 110 billion yen through its wholly owned overseas unit STB Cayman Capital Ltd.
The bonds are yen mandatory exchangeable subordinated guaranteed notes, a bank official said.
The Cayman unit will then buy yen-denominated subordinated convertible bonds, worth up to 110 billion yen, to be issued by Sumitomo Trust itself, he said.
